turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at twenty to five, so let's not waste time. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start by explaining that.
I didn't come for thanks. Who entered that zero before anyone picked up a phone?
Can I ask you something personal? My own manager accused me of using AI on a report last week. How should I defend myself?
That's between you and your employer, Hale. We're here about Owen, and you still haven't told me why I heard about this from my son instead of from you.
Please. You are a lawyer. What should I gather and who should I talk to?
I don't represent you, Hale, and I'm not here to build your case. Twenty minutes. Withdraw the zero, or tell me what you have besides a machine's guess.
